correctness.rationale: Character duality identifies the finite index of the full infinite image of any pinned cylinder with the vector-space dimension of sparse polynomials divisible by powers of \(P(z)=1+z+z^2\). Frobenius and the simple roots at primitive cube roots give the exact valuation of every nonzero support-three polynomial; their subspace linear relations give index dimensions 0, 1, or 2 at every time. A diameter argument and explicit Frobenius-power triple establish both sides of the optimal cutoff. The standalone implementation checked 8,910 triple valuations, 3,002 independent image rank deficiencies, pair separations through 80 and sharp span law through 120; finite checks supplement the full proof.

value.rationale: The classification answers a naturally precise exact-controllability invariant of the first genuinely three-body quadratic additive binary rule: all triple positions, all prescribed bit assignments and all times, with complete image parity-codimension transitions. It reveals two separate arithmetic clocks when three sites share a residue modulo three, and shows arbitrarily delayed joint three-site obstructions despite every pair being immediately controllable. The sharp span cutoff provides a finite spatial design bound and explicit family of extremizers. These are structural consequences beyond qualitative transitivity or a known-table recomputation.
